poem.content:
In twilight's hush, where youth's warm breath
Awakens echoes of a bygone depth,
A dynamic coast, where waves do play,
And the wind whispers secrets all day.

The duck dives deep, a swift sleek dart,
Piercing the surface, a shining heart,
While scouts and agents pace, a vigilant eye,
Watching the horizon, where darkness does lie.

In this realm, a shaft of light does break,
 Illuminating paths, an untrodden make,
A beacon in the dark, a guiding ray,
To navigate the twists and turns of the day.

We scan the skies for omens and signs,
Reading the lyrics of the wind and the vines,
Their whispers weave a tapestry so fine,
A testament to the mysteries divine.

The cook stirs embers, a soul on fire,
As the world outside is reduced to desire,
To protect what's dear, to safeguard what's true,
The heart beats fast, a love anew.

But where the coast gives way to darkest night,
A wheel turns quiet, an eternal sight,
Echoing the cry of a lonely soul,
 Searching for solace, a place to call home.

Yet still, in this quiet, darkness shines a light,
A beacon in the silence, a guiding sight,
The idle moments hold a hidden might,
A whispered promise, a new dawn in sight.
